Who we serve

Solar projects for corporate, public and NGO clients

Each client group buys differently. We shape the proposal, paperwork and payment schedule to the way your organisation procures.

  • 01Corporate

    Lower energy cost at factories and offices

    Rooftop and carport systems sized to your daytime load, with the payback period worked out before you commit.

  • 02Government

    Meet tender and audit requirements

    BOQs, technical specifications and compliance documents prepared for public procurement and ministry review.

  • 03Semi-government

    Power campuses, utilities and institutions

What we do

Project development and component sourcing

Hire us for the whole project or only the parts you need. Both services run from one team under one contract.

Project development

  • Energy audit and feasibility study
  • System design, yield estimate and payback period
  • Net-metering and utility application support
  • Installation, testing and commissioning
  • Operation and maintenance contracts

Component sourcing

  • Solar PV modules: mono PERC, TOPCon and bifacial
  • On-grid, hybrid and off-grid inverters
  • Lithium (LFP) and lead-acid battery banks
  • Mounting structures for roofs and open ground
  • Cables, protection devices and combiner boxes
  • Monitoring systems and energy meters
